name: Vaesen
description: The Vaesen look for every element of the core element kit: the secret box with its red scroll, the open curl frame, pen-nib bullets, Berolina act headings, Playfair Display headings, Libre Baskerville text, Cormorant Garamond read-aloud text and Acme labels (all SIL OFL), and handout papers. Frames and ornaments are the project's own drawings. An unofficial, fan-made look, not affiliated with or endorsed by Free League Publishing.
